mapper.select: SELECT post.post_id, post.title, post.body, post.details::text, post.created_at, post.updated_at, array_to_json(ARRAY( SELECT character.display_name FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(post.details->'relatedCharacters') = 'array' THEN post.details->'relatedCharacters' ELSE jsonb_build_array(post.details->>'relatedCharacter') END ) WITH ORDINALITY AS related(id, position) JOIN catalog_character character ON character.character_id = related.id ORDER BY related.position ))::text FROM review_post post WHERE post.kind = #{kind} AND post.subject_id = #{subject} ORDER BY post.created_at DESC, post.post_id
